doc.state: state for this time input, allows to subscribe to changes to [TimePickerState.hour] and [TimePickerState.minute], and set the initial time for this input.
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this time input
doc.colors: colors [TimePickerColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this time picker in different states. See [TimePickerDefaults.colors].
doc.colors.clockDialColor: The color of the clock dial.
doc.colors.clockDialSelectedContentColor: the color of the numbers of the clock dial when they are selected or overlapping with the selector
doc.colors.clockDialUnselectedContentColor: the color of the numbers of the clock dial when they are unselected
doc.colors.selectorColor: The color of the clock dial selector.
doc.colors.containerColor: The container color of the time picker.
doc.colors.periodSelectorBorderColor: the color used for the border of the AM/PM toggle.
doc.colors.periodSelectorSelectedContainerCo: the color used for the selected container of the AM/PM toggle
doc.colors.periodSelectorUnselectedContainer: the color used for the unselected container of the AM/PM toggle
doc.colors.periodSelectorSelectedContentColo: color used for the selected content of the AM/PM toggle
doc.colors.periodSelectorUnselectedContentCo: color used for the unselected content of the AM/PM toggle
doc.colors.timeSelectorSelectedContainerColo: color used for the selected container of the display buttons to switch between hour and minutes
doc.colors.timeSelectorUnselectedContainerCo: color used for the unselected container of the display buttons to switch between hour and minutes
doc.colors.timeSelectorSelectedContentColor: color used for the selected content of the display buttons to switch between hour and minutes
doc.colors.timeSelectorUnselectedContentColo: color used for the unselected content of the display buttons to switch between hour and minutes
doc.layoutType: , the different [TimePickerLayoutType] supported by this time picker, it will change the position and sizing of different components of the timepicker.
